purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: City-local registration is confirmed by first-party municipal sources. The available service guides and online portal describe rights-registration application workflows; they do not establish public anonymous parcel polygons or a safe feature schema. No geometry or property-specific lookup was requested, and no full polygon was retained.
registryAssessment: The official Benxi Natural Resources Bureau publishes city real-property registration service guides and identifies the Benxi Real Estate Registration Center under the municipal natural-resources service center. The current municipal service portal also lists online real-estate registration. These establish local registry services but not open parcel geometry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Benxi Natural Resources Bureau “不动产登记” service-guide section lists local registration procedures and is hosted by the municipal bureau; it documents an application workflow, not a geometry service.

Official 2026 bureau report states the city Natural Resources Affairs Service Center’s Real Estate Registration Center handles registration intake at the municipal service center; it establishes current local service activity but exposes no parcel geometry.
Official city-bureau organization page describes responsibilities including unified natural-resource and real-property registration and management of the real-property information platform.
Official Benxi integrated government service portal lists “互联网+不动产登记” (Internet + real-estate registration); it is an online application/service workflow, not a public parcel map.
